title: Exorcist 98 Field Report targets (fresh held-out set)

method.summary: Public GitHub repositories of MCP servers and agent configuration, drawn from public lists, pinned to the default-branch commit on the selection date.

awesomeMcp.note: GitHub repository links under "## Server Implementations" (everything after that heading).

awesomeClaudeCode.note: Every GitHub repository link (skills, hooks, CLAUDE.md collections, commands, configs).

mcpServersReadme.note: Checked, not used: at this commit the README no longer carries the community or official-integrations lists (they moved to the MCP Registry).

topicSearch.query: GitHub search API: topic:<t>, sorted by stars, first 30 results; the first N eligible are taken

method.seededRandom: Order candidates by sha256("exorcist-98-wild-scan-round2-2026-11-23:" + lowercase owner/repo) and take the first eligible ones.
method.excludedAlways: The 20 repositories in docs/BENCHMARK.md, forks, private, empty, missing, and repositories over 250 MB on GitHub.
method.order: Pools are filled in the order listed in plan; a repository is taken once, by the first pool that reaches it.

excluded.reason: not found (deleted, renamed away or private)
